name: W. H. Fortier
bio: W. H. Fortier came from Gladstone in April 1885 to relieve a railroad employee here, and a club kept by Mrs. Fortier was dissolved that September. In December 1885 he returned to his old post as agent at Gladstone, where he had bought another farm.

moments.label: Came from Gladstone to relieve the day operator
Resumed his post as agent at Gladstone

mentions: …friends here, not particularly on account of his good looks, but more by reason of his "winning ways." W. H. Fortier, of Gladstone, relieves him here.
The club kept by Mrs. Fortier, has been dissolved on account of losses by marriage and otherwise. Mr. and Mrs. Fortier will keep house in one of the brick cottages.
W. H. Fortier has resumed his old position as agent at Gladstone. He recently bought another farm in that vicinity.
